claim_boundary: protocol freeze only; not a trained hybrid model, calibrated accuracy, production control, learned multiplier interpretability, weak-label coal-quality proof, temporal generalization result, or Yulin/slurry generalization

split_blockers: Current paper-facing set has only 22 representative ModelCases; adequate for protocol smoke and leave-future-out diagnostics, too small for a high-capacity trained hybrid.
Representative rows span four Huayi phases but are not an exhaustive steady-window training set.
Sparse LIMS/coal labels require timestamp alignment rules and train-only preprocessing before they can be used as z_d weak labels.
Yulin/slurry data are out of scope for this protocol unless a separate ModelCase contract is built.

candidate_alpha_groups.name: alpha_wgs
candidate_alpha_groups.implementation_change: none for scalar smoke; bounded alpha(x_t,z_d) wrapper needed for training
candidate_alpha_groups.physical_rationale: WGS directly redistributes CO/H2/CO2 and has already shown 22-case bounded scalar loss-decrease smoke.
candidate_alpha_groups.expected_target_sensitivity: CO, H2, CO2, H2/CO strongest; moderate outlet T through reaction heat.
candidate_alpha_groups.current_evidence: round38/39 bounded WGS scalar smoke; 22/22 loss-decrease, no bound hits.
candidate_alpha_groups.identifiability_risk: High with O/C, steam/water availability, CO2 carrier, and coal-quality weak labels; must report alpha distribution and bound hits.

candidate_alpha_groups.name: alpha_char_oxidation
candidate_alpha_groups.reaction_family: char oxidation / first combustion severity C+O2
candidate_alpha_groups.implementation_change: none for scalar mainline/JAX parameter; bounded alpha wrapper required for training
candidate_alpha_groups.physical_rationale: Controls first-cell heat release, oxygen consumption, CO/CO2 split through phi-coupled char oxidation, and persistent cell0 boundary/source-term behavior.
candidate_alpha_groups.expected_target_sensitivity: outlet T, CO, CO2, dry flow; can interact strongly with O/C response.
candidate_alpha_groups.current_evidence: parameter is already wired into Cell and JAX solver contract; no 22-case bounded training smoke yet.
candidate_alpha_groups.identifiability_risk: Very high with O/C ratio and first-cell initialization; should be introduced after WGS-only baseline and monitored with cell0 cost.

candidate_alpha_groups.name: alpha_volatile_oxidation
candidate_alpha_groups.implementation_change: minimal if exposed as one shared alpha or two bounded alphas; JAX parity coverage should be audited before training.
candidate_alpha_groups.physical_rationale: Existing first-cell combustion branch has explicit CO and H2 oxidation dampers that can localize H2/CO2 mismatch without inventing new source terms.
candidate_alpha_groups.expected_target_sensitivity: H2, CO, CO2, H2/CO; possibly T through oxidation heat.
candidate_alpha_groups.current_evidence: mainline parameters exist; not yet included in 22-case gradient/parity or bounded batch smoke.
candidate_alpha_groups.identifiability_risk: High with WGS and char oxidation; should use staged ablation and bound-hit reporting.

candidate_alpha_groups.name: alpha_char_gasification
candidate_alpha_groups.mapped_existing_parameter: none as a clean grouped op_conds alpha
candidate_alpha_groups.implementation_change: requires small internal interface in Cell/KineticsService to multiply selected heterogeneous rates after rate calculation.
candidate_alpha_groups.physical_rationale: Can address downstream CO/H2 generation and carbon conversion/mass-flow mismatch beyond first-cell oxidation.
candidate_alpha_groups.expected_target_sensitivity: CO, H2, dry syngas flow, carbon sanity; weaker direct effect on early O2 zone.
candidate_alpha_groups.current_evidence: design-only; implement only after WGS/char oxidation baselines are stable.
candidate_alpha_groups.identifiability_risk: Very high with coal reactivity, particle diameter, residence time, and carbon-balance incompleteness.

split_policy.minimum_training_dataset: Use the larger Huayi steady-window ModelCase set once available; 22 representative rows are for smoke/protocol and leave-future-out diagnostics only.

chronological_22_case_diagnostic_split.rationale: preserves future holdout by campaign phase/date; intentionally small and diagnostic-only.

split_policy.leave_future_out: For full steady-window set, train on earliest contiguous blocks, tune on the next chronological block, and report the latest block once. No random shuffling before split.
split_policy.leave_regime_out: Not robust with only 22 representatives. Feasible only after defining regimes by O/C/load/carrier/phase and ensuring at least one complete future-like regime is held out.
lims_weak_label_policy: Align LIMS/coal-quality labels by timestamp using only labels available at or before the ModelCase timestamp.
No interpolation or smoothing may use future labels relative to validation/test rows.
Fit normalization, PCA/latent encoders, imputation medians, and lag windows on train blocks only.
Include LIMS shuffle, delay, and dropout controls before claiming weak-label value.
leakage_guards: No statistics fit on all 22 rows before split.
No phase-level feature_version target leakage into model features unless used only as documented metadata/control.
Repeated rows from same independence group must stay in one split for larger datasets.

baseline_matrix.name: fixed_physics

baseline_matrix.output_schema: case_id, split, target, prediction, residual, solver status, cell0 diagnostics, evidence_boundary
baseline_matrix.tests: adapter tests, diagnostic baseline schema tests, git diff --check
baseline_matrix.runtime_estimate: minutes for 22 cases at N=3/5; larger steady-window set may be hours
baseline_matrix.evidence_boundary: diagnostic baseline only, not calibrated accuracy

baseline_matrix.name: direct_outlet_residual_correction
baseline_matrix.description: Post-solver residual model maps process features to outlet residuals without changing physics.
baseline_matrix.output_schema: case_id, split, target, fixed_prediction, corrected_prediction, residual_before, residual_after, status
baseline_matrix.tests: split integrity, no future leakage, schema, deterministic fit on toy data
baseline_matrix.runtime_estimate: low; no inner differentiable solver training
baseline_matrix.evidence_boundary: statistical residual baseline, not mechanistic alpha_j evidence

baseline_matrix.name: direct_kinetic_parameter_correction
baseline_matrix.description: Fit a small number of global scalar kinetic multipliers with bounds.
baseline_matrix.output_schema: split, alpha_name, alpha_value, bound_hit, metrics, solver diagnostics
baseline_matrix.tests: bound enforcement, monotonic loss smoke, schema
baseline_matrix.runtime_estimate: medium; repeated solver calls per candidate alpha
baseline_matrix.evidence_boundary: bounded global calibration baseline, not learned hybrid interpretability

baseline_matrix.name: bounded_alpha_xt
baseline_matrix.description: alpha_j(x_t) uses online/process variables only with hard sigmoid/logit bounds.
baseline_matrix.output_schema: case_id, split, alpha_j, alpha_value, prediction, metric fields, bound hit, solver diagnostics
baseline_matrix.tests: bound transform, split, deterministic tiny training, no hidden solver API change
baseline_matrix.runtime_estimate: high if trained through solver; start with small N_cells and cached fixed branches
baseline_matrix.evidence_boundary: hybrid readiness until validated on future holdout

baseline_matrix.name: bounded_alpha_xt_zd
baseline_matrix.description: alpha_j(x_t,z_d) adds delayed/weak coal-quality labels or coal latent descriptor.
baseline_matrix.output_schema: all bounded_alpha_xt fields plus z_d availability, lag, source, dropout status
baseline_matrix.tests: no future leakage, LIMS delay/shuffle/dropout controls, split integrity
baseline_matrix.runtime_estimate: high; do only after x_t baseline is stable
baseline_matrix.evidence_boundary: no weak-label value claim unless controls beat x_t-only baseline on future holdout

baseline_matrix.name: time_embedding_only_control
baseline_matrix.description: Use time/phase/position features without process or coal labels.
baseline_matrix.output_schema: case_id, split, target, prediction, metrics, control_status
baseline_matrix.evidence_boundary: detects temporal memorization; not physics correction

baseline_matrix.name: lims_shuffle_delay_dropout_controls
baseline_matrix.description: Controls for weak-label coal features: shuffled, excessively delayed, and dropout variants.
baseline_matrix.output_schema: case_id, split, control_type, z_d_status, metrics, evidence_boundary
baseline_matrix.tests: deterministic shuffle seed, delay rule, dropout mask, no future labels
baseline_matrix.runtime_estimate: medium; repeats alpha training for controls
baseline_matrix.evidence_boundary: required before any weak-label coal-quality claim

runtime_risks: Training through the implicit solver may be slow; start with N_cells=3 smoke and one alpha before multi-alpha/full N_cells.
Persistent cell0 residual-quality flag can dominate diagnostics; report it separately and do not hide it by threshold changes.
Alpha groups are correlated with O/C, load, carrier ratio, and coal weak labels; staged ablations are mandatory.
Bound hits may mimic performance gains; report alpha distribution and hit frequency by split/phase.
The 22 representative rows are too small for high-capacity learned alpha networks; use larger steady-window set before accuracy claims.
LIMS labels are sparse and temporally delayed; future leakage is the highest risk for z_d experiments.
JAX/IFT coverage is partial; full production training may need fallback to fixed-branch probes or careful custom VJP expansion.
